comparison.objective: Check engine oil by pulling, wiping, fully reseating, pulling again to read, reporting the level, and reseating.
comparison.physical_skill: Repeated guided extraction/insertion, bimanual wiping, visual state interpretation, and report-marker placement.
comparison.success_condition: Valid wipe and reseat precede the true reading; the correct level is reported; dipstick and rag are returned without guessing or leaving the engine open.
comparison.reason: The task is an inspection sequence with wiping and conditional reporting. It lacks damper adjustment, lock manipulation, witness-torque retention, and dynamic stopping tests.
